list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades are the official text; hidden flags follow the 27 visible / 28 hidden split those lists report. Counts are the progress targets PSNProfiles lists.

sources.label: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here: it is the finish line of the whole guide. PowerPyx puts the full run at roughly 200 hours — about 60 to 80 hours of story, around 100 hours of checklist work and some cleanup — so treat it as a long project, not a weekend. Work the roadmap in order, keep cheats off (GTABase and TechWiser report that cheats disable trophy tracking and saving), and the platinum takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first story beat of the game and cannot be missed — just play through the intro and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is the first of the hidden story trophies, so with spoilers on it stays masked until you earn it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Chapter trophies are unmissable story progress — keep playing the main missions and this pops at the chapter's end. While you are in Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house: it is reported to count toward Positive Mental Attitude and may disappear once the chapter ends, so grab it early even though that is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Most of the open-world list opens up once both Jason and Lucia are playable, which happens around this point in the story, so Chapter 2 is a good moment to start the side activities and collectibles between missions. The trophy itself is unmissable story progress.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Another unmissable chapter trophy — it pops when the chapter's final mission ends. By now the stranger mission chains and the optional Chapter 4 mission behind Maximum Withdrawal are worth watching for, so keep an eye on new contacts and side missions as they appear.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Before you leave this chapter, make sure you have played the optional mission That is Where The Money Is, the one that unlocks the bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal — it is the only chapter-gated step the early guides flag, so do not rush past the chapter's side content.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. This is the gold story trophy and the last chapter beat. Before you start the final mission, make a manual save: several guides advise keeping a chapter-start save and one before the finale, because there is no mission replay and a couple of side chains are reported to close as the story advances. After the credits, the whole open world stays available for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one are unmissable: they pop when the named mission ends, in story order. No special preparation is needed — just play the mission when it appears.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is one of the named story missions, so it unlocks in story order and cannot be missed. Play it when it appears and the trophy pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. A named story mission trophy: unmissable, earned in story order when the mission ends. No preparation needed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A named story mission trophy: unmissable, earned in story order when the mission ends. No preparation needed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. A named story mission trophy: unmissable, earned in story order when the mission ends. The airport (VCIA) also matters for Catch Me If You Can, so remember the layout for later.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission trophy: unmissable, earned in story order when the mission ends. No preparation needed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own checklist, tracked by PSN as a count to 100. Both GTABase and PowerPyx rank this the hardest trophy, but PowerPyx notes the thresholds are lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — and most of the progress comes from working on other trophies first. The checklist figures Press-Start published: 300 stunts, 30 unique races won, 70 challenges, 15 collectible card sets, 8 bank vaults, and all 42 Shooting Range golds. Note the gaps against the trophies: the trophy for stunts needs only 250, races only 20, challenges only 50, card sets only 3, vaults only 5, so you will bank those trophies on the way. Do this last, after the story, and use the checklist in this guide to see what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, near misses, air time, and the rest of the stunt set the game counts. GTABase and PowerPyx report there are 397 stunts in total, so any 250 count, and flying under bridges is said to be the quickest kind to farm. This is a grind trophy, not a skill gate: keep attempting stunts as you travel and it will tick up on its own. The 100% checklist wants 300, so you will keep going after this pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types in the game once — PSN tracks the count to 9. The game never lists the nine for you, so work through what Leonida offers: races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races, meditation, and the other open-world pastimes, one try each. A single attempt counts; you do not need to win or finish anything for this one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PSN tracks the count to 42. This is a pure skill grind: learn each challenge's target pattern, then repeat it until the gold time or score lands. Do a few challenges between story missions to spread the practice out, and save the hardest ones for after the story when you can focus. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 golds, so this is not optional for the platinum.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — PSN tracks the count to 14. PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 locations, so expect several races per spot and a win at each. Learn the drone's handling on the easiest location first, then work through the rest; a win at a location is what counts, not a win in every race.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — road races, off-road, boat and air races all feed the same count, and each race only counts once, so variety matters more than repetition. The 100% checklist wants 30 unique race wins, so keep racing past this trophy: every win now is progress toward A Long Road too.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the game's activities — find Cal, take the challenge, and out-fish him. It is earnable early and has one of the higher early earn rates on Exophase, so try it as soon as fishing opens up rather than leaving it for cleanup.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, pick any game, and play it through to the end — a single completion is all it takes. This is one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so it pulls double duty.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger mission chain. Stranger chains unlock as the story advances, and TechWiser reports that some of them have windows tied to story progress — only one source gives that warning, so treat it as a caution, not a fact: start Andy's chain as soon as it appears and finish it before moving far past its chapter.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger mission chain. Like the other side-character finals, this is a hidden story trophy that unlocks as you work through that character's missions. Start the chain when it appears and finish it promptly — the early guides warn that stranger chains may be tied to story progress, so do not leave it for after the credits if you can avoid it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger mission chain. A hidden story trophy earned by finishing that character's missions in order. Begin the chain when it unlocks and see it through before the story moves far past it, since the early guides warn stranger chains may close with story progress.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — PSN tracks the count to 8. Strangers appear around the map as the story advances; each strand is a short chain of missions for one character. This silver ties the side-character finals together, so work the stranger missions as they appear instead of saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger mission chain. A hidden story trophy earned by finishing that character's missions in order. Start the chain when it appears and finish it before the story moves far past it, since the early guides warn stranger chains may be tied to story progress.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger mission chain. A hidden story trophy earned by finishing that character's missions in order. Start the chain when it appears and finish it before the story moves far past it, since the early guides warn stranger chains may be tied to story progress.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. GTABase counts 18 spots, while the 100% checklist Press-Start published counts 15 — the two sources disagree, so this guide gives both numbers and does not pick one. This is the one trophy the early guides flag as possibly missable: the first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it is reported to disappear once that chapter ends. Whether that spot is required is unconfirmed, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: EGamers.io (GTABase / PowerPyx: possibly missable, 18 spots; Press-Start: 15)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, as part of his stranger chain. Which animal it is has not been confirmed by any guide yet — EGamers lists it as unconfirmed — so follow Bret's missions and take the hunt when it is offered rather than searching blindly. The trophy is hidden, so it stays masked in the tracker until earned.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — PSN tracks the count to 3. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible, and sets are completed by finding every card in a set. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this silver is only the start: keep collecting as you explore and you will bank the extra sets toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida — PSN tracks the count to 100. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app, and the same scanning also feeds Whip It Good: GTABase reports you discover vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK, with no need to drive them. Scan as you travel and both trophies climb together; busy roads are efficient for finding new vehicles to scan.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — PSN tracks the count to 50. Challenges are the small open-world tasks scattered through Leonida, and they stack up naturally as you play. The 100% checklist wants 70, so keep clearing them after this pops; every challenge finished now is one less in cleanup.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose the cops and escape the heat. GTABase and PowerPyx both point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route, and note that bank vault robberies often bring on the wanted level you need. Get to 4 stars together, break line of sight, and stay out of the red heat zone until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. GTABase's advice, as reported by EGamers: the jewelry stores in North Vice City sit close together, so hit three in a row without letting the wanted level drop. If the trophy does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth — the count may need the extra one to register.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: EGamers.io (GTABase: North Vice City jewelry stores)

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — PSN tracks the count to 100. GTABase reports you discover vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK, with no need to drive them, so scan traffic near busy roads and every new model counts. This pairs with You WAiNKer!, which wants WAiNK used at 100 locations: scan as you travel and both climb together.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. GTABase's advice, as reported by EGamers: fill Focus before you start, use an assault rifle, and aim for gang members — cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count. Find a gang fight with at least five enemies grouped up, trigger Focus, and drop all five before it runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane and leave without a flight plan. GTABase's method, as reported by EGamers: steal a docked passenger jet at VCIA and fly about 1 km away from the airport. Expect a wanted level on the way in, so go in fast and get airborne before the response builds.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhino tanks, and the trophy is about taking enemies out from inside one. GTABase's method, as reported by EGamers: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. Getting the tank out of a military base will draw heavy fire, so plan the escape route before you climb in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone spotting you. GTABase's method, as reported by EGamers: open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, and clear out the safe without being seen. Stealth is the whole trophy — if anyone spots you, back out and try again rather than fighting through it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — PSN tracks the count to 5. This one is gated: GTABase and PowerPyx report it requires the optional Chapter 4 mission That is Where The Money Is, after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars on the escape and have a fast bike ready. Do the Chapter 4 mission before you finish the chapter, then work through five vaults; the 100% checklist wants 8, so keep going after the silver pops.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — intercept one, crack it open, take the cash, and lose the wanted level that follows. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes, and the same skills feed straight into the bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — PSN tracks the count to 52. This means clearing the fog across the whole map: EGamers reports flying over the dark patches is the quickest method. Work through the map region by region in a fast aircraft or helicopter, and the count climbs as each area reveals itself.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: EGamers.io (clear the fog, fly over dark patches)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — PSN tracks the count to 9. GTABase's advice, as reported by EGamers: each gang runs its own operations around the state, so work through them gang by gang and keep a note of which ones you have hit. The operations are repeatable targets, so there is no rush — just one per gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact steps have not been confirmed by any guide yet — PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known, and EGamers lists its steps as unconfirmed. The description itself is the only hint: head to Ocean Beach, find somewhere serving cocktails with a view, and order one. This guide will add the confirmed method once a trusted guide verifies it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No guide has confirmed the exact steps yet: GTABase thinks it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window, but EGamers notes that is unconfirmed. Try driving a car through a showroom's front window — and if it does not pop, wait for a verified method rather than repeating guesses.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley — in other words, go bowling there and finish a game. The trophy is hidden, so its name and description stay masked in the tracker until you earn it. Bowling is also one of the activity types for Master of None, so a finished game here counts toward both.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague, and no guide has fully confirmed the trigger. GTABase's reading, as reported by EGamers: max out Strength for both characters. Treat that as a single-source tip, not a fact — raise both characters' Strength through training and the trophy may pop along the way. If it does not, wait for a verified method rather than grinding blindly.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile — PSN tracks the count to 500. GTABase's reading, as reported by EGamers: 500 actions that change the profile, from a single source, so treat the number as the PSN target and the method as a best guess. Play normally, make decisions that move the profile, and the count climbs. One caution from EGamers: the profile state called Irredeemable is reported to be permanent, so check a Criminal Profile guide before going on a rampage.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the description is the only hint, and no guide has confirmed what triggers this one. PowerPyx marks it as not yet known. It likely pops when something succeeds on a second attempt after a first failure, but that is a guess from the wording, not a verified method. This guide lists it honestly as unconfirmed rather than inventing steps.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the description is the only hint, and no guide has confirmed the trigger. GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but EGamers notes that is unconfirmed. Keep playing, watch for odd encounters in the open world, and this guide will add the confirmed method once a trusted guide verifies it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The exact steps are unconfirmed: PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known. Try a melee swing from a slow-moving vehicle at a pedestrian target, and if it does not pop, wait for a verified method rather than repeating guesses.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — PSN tracks the count to 250,000. Marked Bills come from robberies, and fences launder them for clean cash. GTABase reports one fence pays the most, and notes the total grows naturally during the robberies the 100% run needs anyway. Work the heists and vaults first, then launder what you have banked; the total is cumulative, so it adds up over the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PSN tracks the count to 100,000. Every purchase in any shop counts: weapons, clothes, food, fuel, and everything else. Spend as you play and it climbs on its own; if you are short near the end, buy the most expensive items you still want rather than wasting money. The total is cumulative across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — PSN tracks the count to 8. EGamers reports they are bought through the Vice City Real Estate app and cost around $160,000 in total, and that the 4 story garages do not count toward the eight. Save up, open the app, and buy garages as they appear; money from robberies and laundering Marked Bills will cover the cost.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: EGamers.io (Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PSN tracks the count to 10. Find vehicles you like around Leonida, then register them through the app. Any ten count, so register the ones you come across naturally as you explore and drive; combined with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good, this is a quick cleanup trophy once you know the app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
